data.budget: judgement; vendor claims in 2026-11 partly from secondary blogs
data.claim: Differentiated and defensible: file-glob leases with conflict control (vendor agent teams doc still says avoid same-file edits by splitting ownership by hand), cross-family review independence plus unavailable-not-passed gate semantics, bug-needs-failing-regression-test, event-sourced replayable audit log, no-shell MCP operation. Redundant or at risk from vendors in 12 months: native worktrees, shared task lists with dependencies and TaskCompleted hooks (already in Claude Code agent teams, experimental), managed PR review (Claude Code Review, Mar 2026), scheduled automations (Codex app), agent control planes (GitHub Agent HQ). Speculative: product/test/architecture/change/constellation ops, lifecycle profiles, 24+ harness descriptors, ETA/optimizer; filed in the last 3 days with zero usage evidence. Minimal kernel: queue+DAG, leases+worktrees, gates, review independence, event log, approvals, MCP.
data.falsifier: A vendor ships glob-level file leases or cross-family mandatory review natively, or a persona study shows the ops tracks are used
data.mechanism: Comparison of ddflow's queue and decisions with fetched vendor docs; judgement
data.question: Where is ddflow differentiated, which scope is speculative, and what should it not build because vendors will ship it?

data.budget: read-only, no suite run, load avg 58
data.claim: Measured 2026-11-03 from the event log (132214 events, 36 days): 4137 tasks (2274 open, 1668 done, 195 abandoned), 193 phases (156 open), median 12 tasks/phase, 698 cross-phase need edges with ~50 mutually dependent phase pairs. Completion 34-36 tasks/day (7d, 14d) vs 118/day filed in the same 14 days: backlog grows ~3x faster than it burns; draining 2274 open takes ~9 weeks with zero new intake, ~4.5 at 2x. Hubs: SE-mcp-budget unlocks 540 open tasks transitively, B-am-* ~347, CE-defaults-file 332. Longest open chain 17. Process: mean 62 gate-minutes per merged item, p50 6 / p90 13 gate runs per item, 261 of 1720 completions forced (15%), rubber_duck verdicts fail 62%. Size: 193k LOC src (1047 files), 212k LOC tests (1154 files), 530 config knobs in 50 sections, 88 top-level CLI verbs, 137 MCP tools (16 in lean), 66 event kinds, 24 harness descriptors, 24k commits, events dir 116 MB (~3.2 MB/day, ~1.2 GB/yr).
data.falsifier: A recount differing by more than 5 percent, or a window where the net backlog shrinks
data.mechanism: Python fold of .ddflow/events/*.jsonl plus ddflow --json list task/phase paged; transitive dependents and depth over needs edges of open tasks; token-Jaccard on titles
data.probe: python3 -I fold of .ddflow/events/*.jsonl; ddflow --json list task --limit 1000 --offset N; ddflow --json config --explain; git rev-list --count; wc -l
